title: SEC1: WOLFSSL_MSG absent on most error paths
description:
The file has 37+ error return sites (WC_HW_E, MEMORY_E, BAD_FUNC_ARG, BUFFER_E, etc.) but only 2 WOLFSSL_MSG calls, both in wc_crypto2dev_init(). All error returns from crypto2dev_cipher, crypto2dev_hash, crypto2dev_hmac, crypto2dev_rsa, crypto2dev_ecdsa, and the pool functions are silent.

In the Caliptra reference port and in wolfSSL's own cryptocb.c, WOLFSSL_MSG is present on significant error returns to aid debugging in production builds (WOLFSSL_MSG is a no-op when logging is disabled, so there is no runtime cost concern).

Without these messages, diagnosing hardware errors in the field requires attaching a debugger or adding instrumentation, which increases maintenance burden.

Fix: add WOLFSSL_MSG calls on hard error paths (WC_HW_E returns from ioctl failures, MEMORY_E from XMALLOC failures in the pool, and BUFFER_E in rsa/ecdsa). BAD_FUNC_ARG returns from argument validation can remain silent.
